definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."CompanyCode","d"."MasterFixedAsset","d"."FixedAsset","d"."NationalClassification","d"."TaxDepreciationGroup","d"."RU_LongSerialNumber","d"."RU_WorkwearMaterial","d"."RU_RetiredMasterFixedAsset","d"."RU_RetiredFixedAsset","d"."RU_ProdTraceabilityStartDate","d"."RU_ProdTraceabilityEndDate","d"."RU_AssetTNVED","d"."RU_AssetTransportType","d"."RU_VehicleIdNumber","d"."RU_ManufacturingDate","d"."RU_VehicleEcologicalClass","d"."RU_PropertyAddress","d"."RU_PropertyOwnershipRegnDate","d"."RU_PropertyOwnershipTermnDate","d"."JP_Annex16AssetStructure","d"."JP_Annex16AssetItem","d"."JP_Annex16LeasingAgrmtDate","d"."JP_PrptyTxRptCity","d"."JP_PrptyTxRptClassfctnKey","d"."JP_PrptyTxRptSpclDepr","d"."JP_PrptyTxRptAddlDepr","d"."IN_AssetBlock","d"."IN_AssetPutToUseDate","d"."IN_AdditionalAssetBlock","d"."IN_AssetIsResearchAndDev","d"."IN_AssetIsPriorYear","d"."PT_VehicleTypeByEnergy","d"."PT_VehicleIsWithoutLimit","d"."PT_BigRepairAssetLink","d"."PT_LandAssetLink","d"."PT_AssetReportFormCategory","d"."PT_AmortizedAssetIsReevaluated","d"."IL_InvmtCtrInternalCode","d"."IL_InvmtCtrApprovalDocNmbr","d"."IL_InvmtCtrApprovalVersion","d"."IL_InvmtCtrBogusAssetNumber","d"."IL_InvmtCtrAssetVersion","d"."RS_GroupDeprExclusionYear","d"."RS_AssetLastInvoiceDate","d"."PL_AcquisitionProductionDate","d"."PL_AcquisitionDocumentType","d"."PL_AcquisitionFormNumber","d"."PL_AssetTaxGroup","d"."Country","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_FIXEDASSETCOUNTRYDATA_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_FIXEDASSETCOUNTRYDATA'
